Move is stated beyond the example: the 'When to use' abstracts to any induction/fixpoint/reachability whose plain IH is too weak, carried by a named invariant (potential / invariant pair) plus a self-contained forall k, P k -> P (k+1) step lemma that re-establishes it, with witness-production and disjunction-ruling as extra conditions rather than the whole move. 'When not to use' gives three specific, honest avoid conditions (plain induction suffices -> invariant vacuous; invariant not expressible as a self-contained step lemma because it needs outside state; invariant does not simplify the hard part). Consequences are specific and honest and match the copied code: obligation to re-establish not assume, base case discharge via h : not WinA 0 0 0, witness b_next exists only via the full invariant (a weaker s2<=2k invariant would not derive h10 so no witness), and a concrete failure mode (h12's algebraic step needs a real case split at k=0).
